newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Q4 GDP-A growth revised to 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Q4 GDP-A growth revised to 0.4 pct.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday revised its estimate of December quarter seasonally adjusted GDP-A growth to 0.4 percent from the originally reported 0.5 percent.
September quarter growth was revised to 0.8 percent from 0.6 percent while June quarter growth was left unrevised at 0.3 percent.
Revisions to the previous two years of GDP-A growth estimates are all moderate, ranging between minus 0.2 and plus 0.2 percentage points.
The sum of revisions to GDP-A growth for the two years to December is minus 0.1 percentage points.
The March quarter of 1995 is now very close to showing contraction in growth -- GDP-A grew just A$4 million in that quarter, the latest estimates show.
